acceptance: Stuck jobless runs auto-cancel or alert within 15 min
context: Merged PR #3434: gitignore-lint.yml gained a per-PR cancel-in-progress concurrency group, and tests/unit/workflows/test_workflow_dispatch_dedupe.py now forbids overlapping push+pull_request triggers and requires a per-PR/per-ref cancel-in-progress group on every pull_request workflow. The observed duplicate (CI on opened plus `CI (text edit)` seconds later) is the deliberate edited-event verdict-copy design and was left alone. NOT done: automatic cancel/alert of stuck jobless ghost runs. A watchdog was built and dropped because the Actions API reports a run queued behind a concurrency group the same as a stuck jobless run (queued/pending, zero jobs) and does not expose the group, so cancelling could drop real CI runs. A safe watchdog needs another signal (e.g. runner-side or org-level data); item stays open for that.
description: Every push spawns two CI workflow runs ~13s apart; on 2026-10-12 a jobless ghost run (pending, zero jobs) held its concurrency group and stalled scheduling repo-wide ~45 min until manually cancelled + rerun. Seen on fix/revert-2821 and feat/tuning-merge-settle-recorded.
